description: This is a mock class definition for INetworkManager, using Google Mock framework to create mock implementations of the INetworkManager interface for unit testing. It declares mock methods corresponding to various network management operations.

classes.name: MockINetworkManager
classes.description: A mock class implementing the WPEFramework::Exchange::INetworkManager interface for testing purposes.

methods.name: GetAvailableInterfaces
methods.description: Mocks retrieval of available network interfaces.

methods.name: GetPrimaryInterface
methods.description: Mocks retrieval of the primary network interface.

methods.name: SetInterfaceState
methods.description: Mocks setting the state (enabled/disabled) of a network interface.

methods.name: GetInterfaceState
methods.description: Mocks querying the state of a network interface.

methods.name: GetIPSettings
methods.description: Mocks fetching IP settings for a given interface.

methods.name: SetIPSettings
methods.description: Mocks configuring IP settings for an interface.

methods.name: GetStunEndpoint
methods.description: Mocks retrieving the STUN endpoint configuration.

methods.name: SetStunEndpoint
methods.description: Mocks setting the STUN endpoint configuration.

methods.name: GetConnectivityTestEndpoints
methods.description: Mocks retrieving connectivity test endpoints list.

methods.name: SetConnectivityTestEndpoints
methods.description: Mocks setting connectivity test endpoints list.

methods.name: GetCaptivePortalURI
methods.description: Mocks retrieving URI for captive portal detection.

methods.name: GetPublicIP
methods.description: Mocks obtaining the public IP information.

methods.name: AddToKnownSSIDs
methods.description: Mocks adding a SSID to known list.

methods.name: RemoveKnownSSID
methods.description: Mocks removing a SSID from known list.

methods.name: WiFiConnect
methods.description: Mocks connecting to a WiFi network.

methods.name: WiFiDisconnect
methods.description: Mocks disconnecting from current WiFi network.

methods.name: GetConnectedSSID
methods.description: Mocks retrieving current connected SSID info.

methods.name: GetWiFiSignalQuality
methods.description: Mocks retrieving WiFi signal quality metrics.
